meta.title: LearningLinks: find educators, directly
meta.description: Hi, I'm Link. LearningLinks connects schools, cram schools and families with teachers and tutors. Educators join free. No placement fees, no commissions.

hero.question: What brings you here?
hero.sub: I ask one small question at a time. Nobody here fills in a form.

doors.label: Choose your door

teach.title: I teach
teach.body: Be seen as a person, not a listing. Build your card in about five minutes, and decide who sees it.

school.title: I run a school
school.body: See educators open to full-time or part-time work near your campus, and post your own jobs.

family.title: I'm a parent
family.body: Find a kind, local tutor for your child, with clear hourly rates and no agency fee.

doors.note: All prices include VAT. One payment, 12 months, never auto-renews. No agency fee, no commission.

know.label: Good to know

items.hide: Hide or delete in one click
items.one: Contact shared one at a time

know.docs: We never ask for ID numbers, home addresses or documents.

near.say: Here is who is near you.
near.body: Educators appear by district, never at an address. Join, pick an area, and the people nearby open up as cards.
near.micro: Real profiles are only visible to paying members. The profile and numbers on this page are made up.

map.aria: Sample map of Taiwan with made-up educator counts by area. An illustration, not real data.

sample.name: Emily R.
sample.openSchool: Open to full-time or part-time work

how.title: Three small steps, and I'm with you for each one.

s1.title: Pick your door
s1.body: Tell me whether you teach, run a school or are a parent. It takes one tap.

s2.title: Answer a few questions
s2.body: Educators build a free card in about five minutes. Schools and families join for 12 months, with one payment.

s3.title: Connect directly
s3.body: Members find people near them on a map or a list and reach out themselves. Educators choose what to share, and we never take a cut.

markets.title: Where we are opening
markets.say: Not in Taiwan? Tell me where you are, and I will tell you the day we open there.
markets.waitlistTitle: Get notified when we open in your country

honest.title: Before we begin, one honest thing…
honest.foot: When you sign up, I will ask you to tick a box to say you have read this.

waitlist.success: Thanks. We'll email you when we open in your country.
waitlist.errorEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

atlas.title: Find teachers and tutors near you, on one map.
atlas.sub: Families find private tutors. Schools find full-time and part-time educators. Educators join free.
atlas.doorsSub: Pick your door. Each one opens a different side of the map.
atlas.districtsAria: Sample map of the districts of Taichung City with made-up educator counts. An illustration, not real data.
atlas.districtsNote: Zoom in to a city and its districts appear. Tap one to meet the people who teach there.
atlas.privateSub: Educators are people, not listings. These rules never bend.

members.title: Members only
members.body: Nobody sees an educator without a paid membership. No public profiles, nothing on search engines.

district.title: Districts, never addresses
district.body: Educators appear on the map by district. Nobody's home is ever shown.

contact.title: Contact on request
contact.body: Educators choose what to share. Members ask one educator at a time, and educators can see who asked.

control.title: Hide or delete in one click
control.body: Educators stay in charge of their own card. We never ask for ID numbers, home addresses or documents.
